title: ‘High-value’ drug suspect nabbed with P6.8M meth in Dipolog City
summary: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Police arrested a 36-year-old alleged ‘high-value individual’ and seized around a kilogram of suspected “shabu” or crystal meth in a buy-bust operation…

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Police arrested a 36-year-old alleged ‘high-value individual’ and seized around a kilogram of suspected “shabu” or crystal meth in a buy-bust operation in Dipolog City, Zamboanga del Norte on Friday evening, November 27.
